Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Brilliant's streak charge reward - a tilted battery drops in and charges up with a crackling lime fill and a lightning bolt.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
White reward screen: a large battery tilted about -30deg with a lime-green fill and a dark lightning bolt on its face, the headline "You earned 1 Streak Charge!", explainer text about missing a day without losing the streak, and a dark Continue button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: battery drop and charge fill, ~2s.
- The battery drops in from above with a spin to its final -30deg tilt (spring stiffness 280 damping 12, a visible wobble on landing).
- The lime fill charges from empty to full inside the battery body (900ms, ease-in-out, starting 300ms after the drop begins), the fill edge bubbling slightly.
- The lightning bolt pops onto the fill (scale 0.5 to 1.2 to 1, spring stiffness 400 damping 12) as the charge completes, with a brief white flash across the battery.
- The whole battery does a small energize shake (+-2deg, 150ms) on completion.
- Headline and copy fade and rise below it (250ms each, 100ms stagger), the Continue button settling last (spring stiffness 300 damping 20).

## Calibration
- The charge is the climax: the drop lands first, the fill follows, the bolt punctuates.
- Keep the tilt through the whole sequence - the battery never straightens.

## Reduced motion
Battery fades in full with bolt in place.

## Don't miss
- The fill edge has organic wobble, not a straight clip line.
- The flash on completion is one frame-brief brightness swell, not a strobe.
